nodes.name: A-Lab Solid-State Synthesis Platform
nodes.procedure: The A-Lab robotic platform automates solid-state synthesis: precursor powders (50-100g bottles) are dispensed by automatic balance into plastic vials, mixed with ethanol and 10×5mm ZrO2 balls in dual asymmetric centrifuge (9 min, ethanol amount calculated by powder density), slurry pipetted into alumina crucibles, dried at 80°C. Dried crucibles robotically loaded into box furnaces, heated to 300°C (2°C/min ramp) then to target synthesis temperature (15°C/min ramp) with 4h dwell, naturally cooled to 100°C +10min room temp cool. Products ground with 10mm alumina ball in vertical shaker, sieved through steel mesh for XRD analysis.

unit_operations.name: Powder Dispensing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Prescribed amounts of the precursor powders are dispensed into a plastic vial by an automatic dispenser balance (Quantos, Mettler Toledo)

unit_operations.name: Slurry Preparation
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: mixed thoroughly with ethanol and ten 5-mm ZrO2 balls in a dual asymmetric centrifuge (Smart DAC250, Hauschild) for 9 min

unit_operations.name: Slurry Transfer
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: The resulting slurry is transferred with an automated pipettor (rLine LH-710969, Sartorius) into an alumina crucible

unit_operations.name: Drying
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: dried at 80°C in a closed evaporation system

unit_operations.name: Pre-reaction Heating
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: heated to 300°C with a slow ramping rate of 2°C min^-1 to raise the likelihood that any phosphate precursor has time to react before it becomes volatile

unit_operations.name: Synthesis Annealing
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: then heated to the specified synthesis temperature with a nominal ramp rate of 15°C min^-1, followed by a 4-h dwell

unit_operations.name: Controlled Cooling
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: naturally cooled to 100°C, at which point a UR5e arm removes the samples from the furnace and waits another 10 min to allow the samples to cool to room temperature

unit_operations.name: Product Grinding
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: 10-mm alumina ball placed in crucible, sent to vertical shaker that grinds samples into fine powders

nodes.source_text: Robotic synthesis and characterization... The average exception rate across all stations in the A-Lab is about 3.9% over 1.5 years of operation

nodes.characterization_summary: X-ray diffraction (XRD) is used to characterize synthesis products, with phase and weight fractions extracted by ML models and confirmed by automated Rietveld refinement to assess target phase purity and yield.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The synthesis products are characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), with two ML models working together to analyse their patterns.
